## License

CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): reuse and redistribute, including commercially, with attribution to aifitnessapi.com.

## Source and method

The controlled vocabulary behind https://aifitnessapi.com/glossary, published as data. Each term has exactly one canonical explanation on this site — the href column — and one stable fragment id, so a machine reader can cite the definition it used rather than the top of a long page. The definitions are the site's own editorial definitions written against the vendor documentation cited on the linked pages, not quotations from a standards body. Groups are our sections, not an industry taxonomy.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `term` | The term as it appears in the glossary | string | 0 of 45 rows |
| `definition` | The site's definition of the term | string | 0 of 45 rows |
| `group` | Glossary section the term belongs to | string | 0 of 45 rows |
| `href` | The canonical aifitnessapi.com page explaining this term | string | 0 of 45 rows |
| `anchor` | Stable fragment on /glossary, computed by termId() in the source module | string | 0 of 45 rows |
| `id` | Absolute, citable URL of the term entry (the JSON-LD DefinedTerm @id) | string | 0 of 45 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/glossary.ts` is maintained by hand alongside the pages it feeds; this dataset is regenerated from it with `npm run datasets` in the change that edits it, so it moves when the site's pages move.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
